qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High-value customized technical components engineered into OEM customer equipment create high switching costs and pricing power. Strict P/WC (>45%) decentralized discipline sustains >22% GAAP ROIC across cycles.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Elite Swedish decentralized compounder of ~150 autonomous technical trading subsidiaries. High switching costs via design-in OEM components. Exceptional capital allocation with P/WC > 45% hurdle, 22%+ ROIC, and 15x interest coverage. [5-10Y g: organic volume 2.5% + pricing power 1.5% + self-funded bolt-on M&A 6.0%]
